analogy.rationale: NPY receptors (NPY1R, NPY2R, NPY5R) are G protein-coupled receptors that are poorly expressed in most of these cell lines, so neuropeptide receptor antagonists should elicit little transcriptional response; other GPCR antagonist classes acting on receptors with similarly low expression are the closest analogs.
